`final class UIDataObject`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.core.data` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [UIDataObject.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/core/data/UIDataObject.java)

The options of `@UIData` for a running UI, read from the annotation and changed by its setters.

## Description

[`UI.getData`](/reference/ui/ui/#UI-method-getData) returns it.
Each option has a getter and a setter of the same name, such as `closeable()` and `closeable(boolean)`, and the setter returns the object for chaining; [`UIData`](/reference/annotations/uidata/) gives the meaning of each option.
A change applies from the next frame; `reload()` reads the annotation again and keeps the options that the annotation did not change.

## Learn more

- [UIs](/use/learn/describing-the-ui/uis/#configure-a-ui)

## Properties

| Property | Type | Default | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|
| [backgroundColor](#UIDataObject-property-backgroundColor) | `String` | `"#101010C0"` | Color of the UI backdrop, as a hexadecimal string `#RRGGBB` or `#RRGGBBAA`. |
| [zindex](#UIDataObject-property-zindex) | `int` | `0` | Order of the UI among the open UIs of its bridge. |
| [zlevel](#UIDataObject-property-zlevel) | `double` | `0D` | Depth added along the Z axis before the UI is drawn. |
| [active](#UIDataObject-property-active) | `boolean` | `true` | If `false`, the UI is drawn but receives no input. |
| [visible](#UIDataObject-property-visible) | `boolean` | `true` | If `false`, the UI is neither drawn nor sent any input. |
| [zoomable](#UIDataObject-property-zoomable) | `boolean` | `true` | If `false`, the zoom keys of dev mode leave the zoom of the UI unchanged. |
| [closeable](#UIDataObject-property-closeable) | `boolean` | `true` | If `false`, Escape leaves the UI open. |
| [projection](#UIDataObject-property-projection) | `boolean` | `true` | If `true`, the UI sets its own projection over the window. |
| [background](#UIDataObject-property-background) | `boolean` | `false` | If `true`, the UI draws the UI backdrop behind its nodes. |
| [anchorX](#UIDataObject-property-anchorX) | [`Align`](/reference/layout/align/) | `Align.CENTER` | Side of the window that the canvas is pinned to horizontally. |
| [anchorY](#UIDataObject-property-anchorY) | [`Align`](/reference/layout/align/) | `Align.CENTER` | Side of the window that the canvas is pinned to vertically. |
